title: Ondo Moves to Top of RWA.xyz Distributed-Platform Ranking
why_it_matters: Ondo's overall platform lead combines Treasury products, tokenized stocks and other assets, showing how a multi-product issuer can outrank single-category platforms even without leading every underlying asset class.
caption:
RWA WIRE // MARKET-DATA

Ondo Moves to Top of RWA.xyz Distributed-Platform Ranking

RWA.xyz ranked Ondo first among 203 distributed tokenization platforms on November 5, with $4.07 billion of non-stablecoin asset value across 484 assets.
